subject.title: feat: Control UI debug mode — ephemeral connection logs and error details

question: What pre-auth connection diagnostics may the Control UI expose and make copyable before a trusted operator session exists?
rationale: The code has useful client-side timing hooks, but choosing which auth, device, endpoint, challenge, and close-detail fields are safe to display or copy is a security and product boundary decision.

options.title: Sanitized Client-Only Diagnostics
options.body: Expose only client-side phases, close codes, timing, redacted error codes, and copy support before auth; keep server logs post-auth.

options.title: Authenticated Diagnostics Only
options.body: Keep the login gate to categorized failure guidance and expose richer logs only after operator.read is available.

options.title: Consent-Based Support Export
options.body: Design a broader export that combines redacted pre-auth client diagnostics with authenticated gateway logs after a successful connection.

recommendation.title: Sanitized Client-Only Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Expose only client-side phases, close codes, timing, redacted error codes, and copy support before auth; keep server logs post-auth.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-file history and opened the adjacent focused diagnostics/security-boundary work.
